poli_greeting: I'm Poli, the police officer of this village.
{player_name}. Good. I heard you just arrived today.
Everyone's been looking forward to the village finally getting its one and only restaurant.
If it's alright, would you serve me a dish first?
poli_farewell: That was really delicious. I'll have to come by often from now on.
I already let the villagers know about you. They're probably writing you welcome emails right about now.
mail_hint: Let's check the mail on the computer at home.
Also, you can invite one person to the restaurant per day by email.
As you get closer to the villagers, remember to keep an inventory slot open - you never know when or where they might hand you a gift.
